To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
lead and chromium were detected in candy packages and that the lead contamination was originated in the lead based ink of outer cover.
the heavy metals in candies are mainly from the packaging materials, and the migration of Cr(Vi) and Pb is affected by the pH of the eluting solution.
the heavy metals Pb and Cr are detected at high concentrations and migrate into the elution solutions, and that Cr(VI) is detected in the polypropylene-coating layer of the candy wrappers.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a potential risk of Cr(VI), Pb, and other heavy metals to children.
the contamination of heavy metals in the candy packages that are likely to be consumed and the migration behavior of heavy metals in basic, acidic and neutral solutions.
the migration of heavy metals from candy wrappers to candies.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the migration of heavy metals is dependent on the pH of the elution solution.
the migration of Cr and Pb from polypropylene-coating wrappers was dependent on elution time and pH.
the migration of Pb and Cr(VI) from the candy packages was dependent on pH, and that Pb migrated in all three pH solutions, whereas Cr(VI) migrated only in basic solution.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the lead-based ink on candy packages was the source of Pb contamination in candies, and the Pb contamination in candies could be controlled by replacing lead-based ink with non-lead based ink.
the Pb and Cr levels in candy packages were not hazardous to the consumers.
Cr(VI) and Pb were detected at high concentrations and migrated in basic solution, but Cr(III) and Pb were hardly detected in the candy packages.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of lead-based inks should be avoided in the printing industry.
the migration of heavy metals from polypropylene-coating materials is pH dependent.
Pb and Cr are likely to migrate from the outer cover to the candy package.
